Theodosius Dobzhansky (1900-1975) had an important role in the origin and development of evolutionary genetics in Brazil.

Not only in 1943, when he had been here for the first time, about six months, but also in other moments, for more extended periods, he was responsible for the formation of the first generation of Drosophila geneticists

label: Gave lectures at USP
description: Course on Principles of Evolution for faculty and research group.

sources.quote: However, some comments on the lectures he gave to faculty members and other professionals at the Department of General Biology, University of São Paulo (USP), in 1943 deserve to be made.
He visited Brazil many times after his first visit in 1943, spending one year in 1948-1949 and another in 1955-1956.

description: Spent one year in 1955-1956, the most turbulent of all.

description: Chosen as Honorary President of the meeting in Piracicaba.

sources.quote: He would return in July 1966 for the International Symposium of Genetics, held at Piracicaba, São Paulo – he was then chosen as the Honorary President of the meeting.

description: Congratulated on doctorate, warned about Brazilian 'ambiente'.
